answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor and let standing ripen only across many epochs of peer-audited work, slow as a cedar hardens ring by ring. Each endorsement spends a non-transferable credit from an already-established peer in a SEPARATE funding cluster, a whole orchard of distinct roots not one pond. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches only fold back like a lotus closing on itself and never span distinct clusters; forging 100 heads costs 100 anchors and 100 slow climbs versus honest once.
